context.text: TAC-C did not exist in this planning area before the 2024 Sectional Map Amendment (0.00 acres before, 90.69 after), so every TAC-C property here was placed in the zone in 2024.

ref.detail: Table 1, Prior and Approved Zoning Inventory

context.text: The amendment rezoned land including properties on Town Center Boulevard from TAC-E to TAC-C "to create the Core of the Bowie Local Town Center" (master plan strategy CZ 5.1; changes ZC 60-62).
The 2024 amendment uses TAC-E for the edge of the Bowie Local Town Center (master plan strategy CZ 5.2), for example ZC 58 (CGO to TAC-E) and ZC 59 (LCD to TAC-E).
It also moved other TAC-E land out of the center "to limit mixed-use development outside of the center" (ZC 65-71), and TAC-E fell from 606.91 to 454.20 acres.
No zoning map amendment can now place land in LCD, so the zone only shrinks as sites move out of it.

ref.detail: §27-4205(a), zoning of land to LCD prohibited

context.text: The 2024 amendment cut LCD in this planning area from 4,177.77 to 2,870.63 acres, moving some of it into the town center, for example ZC 59 (LCD to TAC-E, 17.75 acres).

legacy_rule.text: The use tables do not apply in LCD. Development follows the site's approved Basic Plan, Comprehensive Design Plan (CDP) and Specific Design Plan (SDP), and the uses permitted are those of the comprehensive design zone the land was in before April 1, 2022.

overlays_not_checked: Aviation Policy Area (APA) overlays are not in the county layers we query, so they are not checked.

uses.label: restaurant (quick-service, no drive-through)

Bars/Night Clubs.note: A bar that serves food is a restaurant under the ordinance; a nightclub is a separate use. We read this recommendation as a nightclub, the stricter case.

uses.row: Medical or dental office or lab
uses.label: medical or dental office

Post Office, Police Station Courthouse,.note: The use tables list police and fire stations as "Emergency services facility" but have no row for a post office, courthouse or DMV. Government buildings may be exempt from the use tables under another section, which we have not confirmed.

Gym/Fitness Center.note: The ordinance has no gym row. We read a gym as "Recreation facility, indoor"; a small studio could instead fall under the art, dance and yoga studio row.

Religious Institution/buildings.note: Places of worship on lots under 2 acres, or in converted houses, have their own rows; this uses the general row.

Vertical mixed used buildings.note: The ordinance has no single mixed-use row. A mixed-use building is several principal uses on one lot, which §27-5101(b) allows when each use is allowed, so this needs both housing and ground-floor retail.

Big Box Shops.note: "Big box" is a building form, not a use. We read it as large retail (consumer goods or combination retail).

Strip Mall.note: A strip mall is a development form, not a use. We read it as retail stores.

Shopping Mall.note: A shopping mall is a development form, not a use. We read it as retail stores.

Surface parking lot.note: A parking lot serving a store is an accessory use; this is the row for a lot as a principal use.

uses.row: Arboretum or botanical garden, park or greenway, or public water-oriented recreational and educational area
uses.label: botanical garden or park

Plaza/Square/Courtyard.note: The ordinance has no plaza row. We read a public plaza as "park or greenway"; a plaza inside a private development is usually required open space, not a principal use.

Farmers Market.note: This is the permanent-use row. A market run as a temporary use follows the temporary use table (Section 27-5301), which is not checked yet.

Community Center or Library.note: The ordinance has no community center row. We read it as a cultural facility or a nonprofit recreational use.
